Name: Baechu Styled Sprite For Morris
Author: madybara
Description: This mod changes Morris' sprite so that he looks more consistent with the Baechu style portrait. This mod is also for yoshimax's Marry Morris mod. I remade the models in the folder for Morris. I noticed this wasn't a thing so I decided to make it after seeing to drastic difference between the portrait and the sprite, enjoy!! <3

Downloads.Description: Baechu Styled Sprite For Morris. I also reworked yoshimax's Marry Morris sprites to fit the Baechu style. A big thank you to both of these wonderful creators for making this possible. :3
